extension.description: SPURSPLAY is the official streaming platform of Tottenham Hotspur Football Club, offering fans exclusive access to a wide range of content, including live and on-demand videos.
extension.disclaimer: This is an UNOFFICIAL plugin NOT endorsed by Tottenham Hotspur. Some content requires a SPURSPLAY subscription.
extension.news: Version 0.3.0: - Fix broken login: SPURSPLAY moved sign-in to Auth0 Universal Login, so the old direct login endpoint no longer worked. Also fixes a bug where the login token failed to save, forcing a fresh login on every screen and triggering CAPTCHA blocks. - Make live content pausable via inputstream.adaptive, instead of Kodi's built-in player treating live streams as non-seekable. - Clean up the main menu: fix a crash on some entries, drop outdated or stale ones, and add some new categories. - Show each video's air date. - Now requires Kodi Nexus (v20) or later.
